## A. UniBlocker protocol: smallest k reaching PC >= 90%

Protocol: `C = union over a in A of topK(a -> B)`, k capped at 100, `PC = |C & G| / |G|`, `PQ = |C & G| / |C|`, `mAP = sum_k (PC_k - PC_{k-1}) PQ_k`. `G` is the raw positive list, not the transitive closure.

|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `fodors_zagat` | `sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2` | 112 | 112 | 1 | 99.11 | 20.83 | 20.69 | 2 | 93.75 | 9.85 | 53.42 |
